description: Runs the Android Automotive build of Google Maps (26.10.120003.E) on BYD DiLink 3 head units (Android 10) with MicroG-RE 7.3.0: sign-in, map, search, navigation and voice, UI density, driver side and color scheme settings, 3D buildings in the map layers, the car's battery for EV routing (on by default on the tested BYD Dolphin) and the battery to arrive with at charging stops and at the destination, Send to car from phone Maps with a car name you choose, an in-app problem report that is sent only after you review it, a daily check for a newer release, and a safe mode with feature switches. The app is named "Maps" unless you set another name in the App name option. BYD battery, Send to car, the BYD location flicker fix, BYD navigation volume and 3D buildings are separate patches. Requires Morphe Desktop 2.1.0 or newer.

patches.name: 3D buildings
patches.description: Adds Maps' own 3D buildings to the map layers. Google hides them in this app.

patches.name: BYD battery (EV)
patches.description: Feeds the BYD battery into Maps' EV routing (battery on arrival, chargers). On by default on the tested BYD Dolphin, off with an "untested" notice on other BYD models; a Settings row turns it on or off and sets the battery to arrive with at charging stops and at the destination.

patches.name: BYD location flicker fix
patches.description: Holds back BYD's brief location off/on flips for up to 3 s, so Maps does not flash its location lockout.

patches.name: BYD navigation volume
patches.description: Plays Maps' spoken directions on BYD's navigation volume instead of the media volume.

patches.name: Google Maps Automotive for MicroG-RE
patches.description: Runs Google Maps for Android Automotive on Android 10 with MicroG-RE 7.3.0, named "Maps" unless the App name option says otherwise. Adds UI density, driver side and color scheme settings, a problem report, an update check and a safe mode.

options.description: The name in the launcher and the app list. Up to 30 letters, digits, spaces and - _ . ' & ( ) + ! : characters, starting with a letter or digit. The problem report's launcher entry is "Report" and this name. Phone Maps is called Maps too: pick Maps Car to tell them apart.

patches.name: Send to car
patches.description: Lets phone Maps send a trip to the head unit through MicroG-RE (push routes, the notification service identity and maps.app.goo.gl links). Adds a Send to car row in Settings: a status check and the car's name in phone Maps (default "Vehicle 1").

release_notes:
### New

- **Color scheme** in Settings: Auto, Day or Night. BYD keeps the head unit in night mode, so Maps showed night colors all day. Auto uses night colors only while the low beam is on.
- **Updates** in Settings: Once a day the app checks for a new release (you can turn this off) and posts one silent notification per version. Patch new versions with Morphe Desktop.

### BYD battery

- On cars with BYD's energy table, Maps plans with that table adjusted for your car. The app measures what the A/C and electronics draw while the car stands, and compares the battery each guided route uses with Maps' forecast.
- The dialog also shows battery health and temperature, Maps' forecast against arrival for recent guided drives, and **Export records**.

### Send to car

- The Settings row checks MicroG-RE's battery whitelist, push registration and the network, and shows the car's name and the last trip received.
- Problem reports also show what Send to car depends on.
- Keep MicroG-RE's **Device registration** on and turn off Maps in BYD's **Disable Autostart** (README, Install).

Needs Morphe Desktop 2.1.0 or newer.

Tested on a BYD Dolphin (DiLink 3.0, Android 10) with Google Maps (Android Automotive) 26.10.120003.E and MicroG-RE 7.3.0. Other BYD models are untested, and BYD battery does not support plug-in hybrids (DM-i).

Setup: [README](https://github.com/fangkampanat/google-maps-automotive-patches#install).
